# noise.js

Seeded pixel noise for the noise guaranteed brand, copied unchanged from
[noiseguaranteed.github.io](https://github.com/noiseguaranteed/noiseguaranteed.github.io)
(`js/noise.js`, branch `brand-refresh`, commit `259a54f`). GPL-3.0, as that repo.

Kept here rather than loaded from the site so the editor works offline and
from `file://`. To update, copy the file again and change the commit above.
The brand rules it follows are in that repo's `BRAND.md`.
